CLIFFSIDE REFINERY WARREN — ochre-leather scavenger outfit with rusted iron gauntlets, goggled half-mask pushed onto forehead, dust-weathered duster coat flapping, brown hair tied back; figure stands on jagged canyon-edge girder overlooking a vertical industrial hive carved into rust-red rock.

CORPORATE ARCOLOGY PLAZA — sleek black-and-magenta tactical bodysuit with chrome shoulder plates, slim holstered sidearm, no helmet, platinum-blonde hair in tight bun; figure crosses a rain-slicked obsidian plaza toward a five-hundred-story arcology complex bristling with antennae.

DESERT MOISTURE-FARM EXPANSE — sand-tan tactical suit with moisture-recycler vest, face-wrap covering nose and mouth, tinted goggles, heavy utility belt with canteens and sample-pouches, dark curly hair visible above wrap; figure stands atop crumbling stone aqueduct surveying endless sand punctuated by solar-collector arrays.

FOREST CANOPY RANGER OUTPOST — forest-green armored cloak over segmented tactical suit, hood pulled back revealing red hair in braid, climbing harness with rope coils, holstered carbine, biometric scanner on forearm; figure perched on massive branch-city platform among continent-spanning mega-trees.

ORBITAL SHIPYARD GANTRY — olive-drab military EVA suit with bulky life-support backpack, mirrored helmet visor reflecting starfield, tactical webbing with mag-clamps and welding tools, unit patches on shoulders; figure mag-locked to construction gantry amid skeletal starship frames in zero-g drydock.

ARCTIC RESEARCH STATION APPROACH — white sealed parka with thermal-gel insulation panels, tinted goggles frosted at edges, breathing-mask with vapor exhaust, fur-trimmed hood, black hair dusted with snow; figure trudges across ice-sheet toward cluster of geodesic habitation domes and radio towers.

UNDERGROUND FUNGAL CITY — burgundy hooded cloak over armored bodysuit, sigil-engraved bronze chestplate, hood framing dark skin and silver-grey hair, gauntlets with built-in cutting tools, belt-pouches with spore-collection vials; figure stands on balcony carved from living stone overlooking bioluminescent fungal architecture.

DIESELPUNK MINING-RIG PLATFORM — brass-and-rust explorer jacket with oversized riveted shoulder-guards, goggled helmet with flip-down loupes, bandolier thick with tool-pouches and sample-containers, black gloves oil-stained, brown hair pulled through helmet back-strap; figure braced against railing as massive drilling platform churns through asteroid field.

TIDE-LOCKED TERMINUS CITY — charcoal-grey power armor with red service stripes, bulky helmet with triple-visor array, heavy mag-boots, shoulder-mounted equipment pods, utility gauntlets with built-in displays; figure stands on observation deck where eternal daylight meets eternal night, city spanning the terminator line.

MONASTERY FORTRESS MOUNTAIN — deep-purple tactical robe over segmented under-armor, hood with silver-embroidered constellation patterns, armored boots with climbing spikes, gauntlets bearing circuit-like engravings, blonde hair in warrior's top-knot; figure meditates on monastery wall overlooking cloud-sea and distant peaks.

COASTAL WRECK-SALVAGE YARDS — teal-and-brown mercenary jumpsuit with mismatched armor plates bolted on, no helmet but leather cap with goggles pushed up, multi-tool belt with plasma-cutter and grapple-gun, red hair cropped short; figure stands atop crashed starship hull surveying kilometers of ship-graveyard beach.

GEOTHERMAL POWER COMPLEX — orange-and-black industrial suit with heat-reflective panels, breather-mask hanging at neck, utility harness with radiation badges and temperature sensors, protective goggles, dark skin glistening with condensation, hair in protective wrap; figure inspects pressure-gauge on catwalk over lava-lake power-station.

LIBRARY-SHIP HANGAR BAY — cream-and-gold scholar's armor with book-shaped chest-piece, ornate helmet under arm showing dark braided hair, equipment pouches containing data-slates and scanner-tools, ceremonial sidearm; figure stands in hangar where knowledge-preservation vessels dock inside hollow asteroid converted to archive.

CANYON-CITY MARKET TIERS — sun-bleached canvas vest over mesh armor bodysuit, hood with attached breathing-filter folded back, tool-belt with climbing gear and specimen-containers, brown leather gloves, black hair with red dust-coating; figure navigates crowded market-tier built into slot-canyon walls, multiple levels connected by rope-bridges.

ZERO-G AGRICULTURAL SPHERE — forest-green maintenance coveralls with transparent helmet, life-support backpack compact for interior work, utility harness with pruning tools and harvest bags, auburn hair floating in micro-gravity; figure drifts through center of rotating agricultural-sphere, crops growing on interior surface in all directions.

BRIDGE-CITY BETWEEN SKYSCRAPERS — slate-grey tactical fatigues with kevlar vest-rig, climbing-harness with rope-coils, helmet with fold-down ballistic visor raised, utility gauntlets, short blonde hair, rifle slung across back; figure walks suspension-bridge spanning gap between mega-towers, bridge itself a full neighborhood of shops and dwellings.

POLAR RING-CITY TRANSIT — midnight-blue cold-weather armor with built-in heating elements glowing faintly orange at seams, insulated hood with ice-prevention coating, breather-mask with condensation-capture, heavy insulated gloves, brown hair frosted with ice; figure waits at transit platform as tram-cars speed past on magnetic rails circling planet's pole.

CORAL-ANALOG REEF-PLATFORM — cobalt-blue dive-armor with gill-breather system, helmet with transparent face-plate showing dark skin and concerned expression, propulsion-pack for underwater navigation, gauntlets with sample-collection tools; figure surfaces at floating research-platform amid planet-wide ocean dotted with coral-towers grown by unknown process.

CRATER-RIM MEMORIAL SITE — ivory ceremonial armor with battle-damage preserved, crimson cloak weathered by exposure, helmet hanging from belt showing grey hair cut military-short, memorial-wreath in hands, sidearm holstered; figure stands at crater-rim where city once stood, now glass and rubble, memorial-markers surrounding observation point.

SPORE-TOWER QUARANTINE ZONE — yellow hazmat-suit with reinforced seals, full-face respirator with filter-cartridges, decontamination-sensor badges, utility belt with specimen-containers and analysis-tools, red hair visible through face-plate; figure documents fungal growth overtaking abandoned district from safe observation tower.

ASTRO-RAIL JUNCTION PLATFORM — copper-brown engineer's armor with tool-loops and maintenance-patches, work-helmet with integrated headlamp, heavy-duty gloves, equipment belt with diagnostic-scanners, black hair in practical braid; figure inspects rail-junction where magnetic tracks converge from five directions, station-complex hovering in zero-g between mining-operations.

TEMPLE-CITY PROCESSIONAL — white ceramic armor with gold circuit-patterns, cape of light-fabric attached to shoulders, ornate helmet under arm revealing shaved head with ceremonial tattoos, gauntlets with prayer-wheels built into knuckles, sidearm ornamental; figure leads procession along elevated causeway toward temple-pyramid at city-center.

SANDSTORM RUNNER CHECKPOINT — rust-red tactical suit with sand-deflection coating, face-wrap and goggles essential, moisture-recovery vest, leg-wraps over reinforced boots, utility belt with navigation-beacons, black hair in wrapped braids; figure checks supplies at checkpoint-shelter as sandstorm wall approaches, racing to secure site before arrival.

CRATER-LAKE RESEARCH FLOTILLA — charcoal-grey aquatic-suit with propulsion-jets, transparent helmet showing concerned expression and blonde hair, equipment-harness with water-sampling tools, flotation-vest integrated, boots with magnetic-soles for deck-walking; figure works on research-vessel deck as flotilla studies crater-lake of liquid methane on frozen moon.

VERTICAL-FARM TOWER INTERIOR — jade-green agricultural-suit with knee-pads and elbow-reinforcement, transparent face-shield flipped up showing brown skin and friendly smile, tool-belt with pruning equipment and harvest-bags, gloves with grip-coating, hair in protective cap; figure tends crops on interior balcony of thousand-floor agricultural tower, each floor a growing-zone.

WRECK-FIELD SALVAGE DRIFT — black-and-silver space-suit with thruster-pack, tool-harness with plasma-cutter and grapple-gun, helmet with heads-up-display visible through face-plate showing dark hair and concentration, magnetic-boots deactivated for drift; figure navigates zero-g wreck-field of ancient battle, salvaging components from dead warships.
